**1 — Scene:** A leafy green salad with cooked cauliflower and roasted potato pieces. The leaves and potatoes appear lightly oily.

**2 — Vessel:** A rounded rectangular dinner plate, approximately 27 × 25 cm. Using an equivalent diameter of **26 cm**, its area is 3.14 × 13² = **531 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Mixed leafy greens, cauliflower florets, roasted potatoes, and a light oil/dressing sheen. Small vegetable fragments are included with the greens.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:** Food covers approximately **65%** of the plate. Assigned areas are non-overlapping estimates; dressing coats the food rather than occupying a separate area.

| Item | Plate coverage | Area | Typical height | Gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Leafy greens | 38% | 202 cm² | 2.5 cm | 505 ml | 0.15 g/ml | 76 g | 20 | 15 kcal |
| Cooked cauliflower | 15% | 80 cm² | 2.5 cm | 200 ml | 0.60 g/ml | 120 g | 25 | 30 kcal |
| Roasted potato pieces | 12% | 64 cm² | 1.8 cm | 115 ml | 0.65 g/ml | 75 g | 110 | 83 kcal |
| Oil/light dressing | Coating | — | — | ~6 ml | ~0.92 g/ml | 6 g | 884 | 53 kcal |

Coverage check: **38% + 15% + 12% = 65%**. Oil is estimated separately from the visible sheen, and is not also included in the potato energy density.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **277 g and 181 kcal** is plausible for this loose mound of greens, several substantial cauliflower florets, and a small handful of potato pieces. Dressing quantity is the largest energy uncertainty.
